warnings.text: BERTRIX GLIDER ACT RADIUS 05NM EXC LFFF FIR. OPERATIONS ON FREQ 130.130 MHZ

GLIDER ACT RADIUS 05NM EXC EHAA FIR. CROSSING OVERHEAD BELOW 3000FT AGL MUST BE AVOIDED DUE TO WINCH LAUNCHING. CONTACT PRIOR ENTERING IS REQUESTED VIA WEELDE RADIO 119.605 MHZ OR WEELDE AIR CADETS 118.015 MHZ.
